items.prompt:
Design a complete, professional logo for the brand "Sébastien Blanc" (plâtrier peintre: Plâtrerie et plaques de plâtre, Enduits et lissage, Peinture intérieure), as a top branding agency would present it — the logo artwork only, not a mockup.
Positioning: Finitions intérieures soignées, du plâtre à la peinture, pour des intérieurs nets. Clients: Particuliers qui rénovent leur logement autour de Mâcon. Personality: précis, artisan, fiable.
Creative direction "Logotype pur": Le nom « Sébastien Blanc » seul, dessiné avec soin : la typographie porte toute la personnalité.
Style: TYPOGRAPHIC logo: the name itself is the design — custom-feeling lettering, a ligature or a typographic detail linked to the trade, contrast of weights or of two colours; no separate icon, or only a tiny integrated accent.
Composition: the name alone (lettering), with any accent integrated into the letters. Typography: grotesque sans-serif, bold weight, title case, normal letter-spacing.
Colours: the brand palette — main ink #141B1F, accent #446274, also available #D0D8DD, #747FB4, #F2F5F7; white or near-black only if needed.
Text in the logo, spelled EXACTLY with the same accents and spaces: the name "Sébastien Blanc". No other words, no slogan, no fake or extra letters.
Nothing is imposed: no shape, object, initials, texture or composition is required beyond this direction. An object or gesture of this business (here, for example: trowel, ruler, paint) may be used when it is integrated in an original, professional way. Also avoid: wall, bricks, palette, trowel (literal). Never copy or imitate an existing logo.
Quality bar: a real agency-quality logo, drawn with care and personality, every element deliberate; refined details and a precise finish; a deliberate typographic treatment of the name (weights, spacing, hierarchy with the activity line), not a default font simply typed; balanced proportions; a mark that could only belong to this business and would not look out of place in a premium branding portfolio.
Avoid poor concepts: a plain circle, triangle or rounded square used as the symbol with no graphic idea; a generic stamp or seal with no personality; letters simply placed inside a square or circle frame; a standard font with no composition; a symbol that could belong to any company; decoration added without intent; stock-icon clichés. Simple shapes are welcome only when they carry a real idea (a cut, a negative space, a construction, a double reading).
No people: no person, face, hands or human silhouette.
Output: crisp edges, centered, generous margins, on a plain transparent or pure white background. No mockup, no paper, no wall, no photo, no frame around the canvas.
